newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA foreign shares hit new year low.
newsitem.headline: SIA foreign shares hit new year low.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd's (SIA) foreign share tranche hit a new year low of Singapore $11.90 on Friday, down S$0.30 from its previous low point.
"Lacklustre results are expected from SIA as they have been so far from the blue chips," said an analyst with a local firm.
"I think the drop is in line with the way the whole market is dipping today," said a dealer with a local brokerage.
More than 1.6 million SIA foreign shares had changed hands by 0800 GMT and an hour before the day's close the stock stood at S$12.00.
SIA's financial year ends on March 31. The group reported operating profits of S$1.045 billion in fiscal 1995-96, up 12.3 percent year on year.
But the airline's operating profit fell 7.4 percent to S$756.0 million from S$817.0 million in 1994-95.
"The airline will have to work harder and smarter in combating the elements that weakened its 1995-96 performance," managing director Cheong Choong Kong said announcing the results.
